questions.q: What does Micah say Zion will be plowed like?
questions.evidence: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest

questions.q: Under what will everyone sit, with no one to make them afraid?
questions.evidence: But they will sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree

questions.q: Out of which small town will the ruler of Israel come?
questions.evidence: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be ruler in Israel

questions.q: What does Yahweh require, according to Micah 6?
options: Justice, mercy, and a humble walk
questions.evidence: What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God

questions.q: Where will God cast all their sins, Micah ends?
options: Into the depths of the sea
questions.evidence: and you will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea
